title: Soda Fire Workshop at Tin Barn Pottery
bring: Bisque fired Cone 10 pots (bowls under 10" diameter, cups, vases, containers only; no plates or platters)
source_quote:
Soda Fire Workshop at Tin Barn Pottery, April and June 2016
All Levels Welcome
Cost $135
summary: Two soda firing workshops (April and June 2016) at Tin Barn Pottery. Bring bisque-fired cone 10 work; potters pay $135 and participate in loading, firing, and learning soda firing techniques.
evidence_sentence: The workshops page describes soda firing workshops that teach flashing slip and glaze application, wad clay coloring, and soda ash effects on clay and kiln.
evidence_quote: We will be firing a soft brick, downdraft gas kiln to cone 10 with soda ash.
